limits: Chardonnay and Chenin together: at most 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for quality sparkling wine in which Chardonnay is the main grape. Chenin, Mauzac and Pinot Noir are also allowed, across about 40 communes around Limoux in the Aude.
